message: docs: specify usage of the placeholder tag (#448)

pr.title: docs: specify usage of the placeholder tag

linkedIssues.title: Placeholder tag documentation doesn't mention it is only used for flags
linkedIssues.body:
The documentation is not clear on what the `placeholder` tag actually does. Digging in the code, I found that it is (I think) only ever used to print help for _flags_, not `cmd`s or positional `arg`s.

This command struct:
```go
type FooCmd struct {
  barArg string `arg:"" name:"bar-arg-name" placeholder:"disregarded_placeholder" help:"Help text for barArg."`
  bazFlag string `placeholder:"<PLACEHOLDER>" help:"Help text for bazFlag."`
}
```

gives the following help:
```console
$ foo --help

Usage: foo <bar-arg-name>

[...]

Arguments:
  <bar-arg-name>    Help text for barArg.

Flags:
      --baz-flag=<PLACEHOLDER>    Help text for bazFlag.
```

I was initially under the impression that `<bar-arg-name>` would actually display as `<disregarded_placeholder>` instead.

I'm not sure if this is simply a matter of updating the [README.md](./README.md) or if this should also be documented in the go docs.

diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index cbe6224..205899f 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -561,7 +561,7 @@ Both can coexist with standard Tag parsing.
 | `name:"X"`           | Long name, for overriding field name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
 | `help:"X"`           | Help text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
 | `type:"X"`           | Specify [named types](#custom-named-decoders) to use.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
-| `placeholder:"X"`    | Placeholder text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
+| `placeholder:"X"`    | Placeholder input, if flag. e.g. `` `placeholder:"<the-placeholder>"` `` will show `--flag-name=<the-placeholder>` when displaying help.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
 | `default:"X"`        | Default value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
 | `default:"1"`        | On a command, make it the default.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
 | `default:"withargs"` | On a command, make it the default and allow args/flags from that command                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

explanation.what: README.md のタグ一覧表にある placeholder:"X" の説明文を、「フラグにのみ適用され、ヘルプ表示で --flag-name=<placeholder> のように使われる」ことを明記する記述に変更した。
explanation.why: linkedIssues #447 で、placeholder タグが positional な arg やcommandには効かずフラグ専用であることが文書から読み取れず誤解を招くと報告されたため、その旨を明記した。
